relationships.subject: Dex/Lid@PLX/HA hydrogel
relationships.evidence_quote: Dex/Lid@PLX/HA significantly inhibited both NF-κB translocation and COX-2 expression (P < 0.05)

relationships.subject: Dex/Lid@PLX/HA hydrogel
relationships.evidence_quote: the hydrogel-based systems, particularly Dex/Lid@PLX/HA, produced a progressive reduction of TRPV1 expression

relationships.subject: Dex/Lid@PLX/HA hydrogel
relationships.evidence_quote: Dex/Lid@PLX/HA significantly attenuated CGRP overexpression (mean diff. = −2.47 versus Injury, P = 0.0028)

relationships.subject: TNF-α
relationships.evidence_quote: TNF-α stimulation triggered robust NF-κB nuclear translocation and the downstream up-regulation of cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2)

key_findings: Sustained Dex/Lid release from PLX/HA hydrogel reduced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in CCI rats better than solution or PLX gel.
The hydrogel suppressed COX-2, DRG/dorsal horn TRPV1, CGRP and SGC activation, and shifted macrophages toward CD163+ reparative phenotype.
